label: Bible Study
prompt: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as _____ in the world;
verse: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;
note: Shining like stars in a crooked world — Paul's picture of a faithful church.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt _____ him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.
verse: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.
note: Even scattered among the nations, Moses promises, seek Him with all your heart and you shall find Him.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the _____.
verse: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.
note: The servants filled the waterpots to the brim — and by the time it was drawn out, the water had become good wine.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the _____ of sins.
verse: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.
note: Love refuses to keep a ledger — Peter likely echoes Proverbs 10:12, 'love covereth all sins.'

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But we all, with open face beholding as in a _____ the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.
verse: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.
note: In the KJV a 'glass' is a mirror — beholding the Lord's glory, we're changed 'from glory to glory.'
